subject: [hw] opus-venc -> V40 (optional): power VENC core around each GCE flush + always signal the callback; text in fakevenc/apply_patches.py
body: In GCE mode vpud never sends VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_POWER_ON; Linux powers the core in vcu_gce_set_cmd_flush (venc_encode_prepare when gce_job_cnt==0, mtk_vcu.c:994) and unprepares in the callback (:822). In vcu_gce_flush_ioctl: if codec_type==VCU_VENC and hw.power: power(core_id?RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1:RWVC_BLK_VENC,1) before gce_run_list, 0 after; and h->flush_done++ even when rc!=0 (cmdq runs the callback for a timed-out packet too, so the daemon wait never hangs); keep returning rc so your 1377 checks stay green (verified: N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377 with it). IV currently powers from the runner, so this is not blocking.
